name: Interactive Multi-pipe 4D Rendering
definition: An interactive rendering algorithm for time-varying oceanography data on multi-pipe graphics hardware (e.g., SGI Onyx2) that partitions volume data into bricks to fit into texture mapping hardware, achieving interactive frame rates by minimizing texture swapping.
summary: Interactive Multi-pipe 4D Rendering is a parallel algorithm that partitions time-varying volume data into bricks distributed across multiple graphics pipes to enable real-time interactive visualization of datasets exceeding texture memory limits.
